vecUnachieved.strDescription: Your first step on a grand karting adventure!

data.strFullDescription:
[p][b]Oh Baby！賽車時間到啦！[/b]
[/p][p]
[/p][p]歡迎來到 [b]OH BABY! KART[/b]，一場史無前例、令人熱血沸騰的賽車狂歡！獨創的飄移加速與終極技能玩法，讓你體驗前所未有的速度與激情！挑選你的車手，打造專屬卡丁車，準備引擎轟鳴，衝向賽道吧！
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]飄移終極技能[/b]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/d5b013c371693af41e63528c3398379c.poster.avif?t=1760426386" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/d5b013c371693af41e63528c3398379c.webm?t=1760426386" width="616" height="158"][/imgvid]飄移不僅賦予你速度，更賦予你終極力量！是追求極致速度的提升？還是渴望火箭般的推進？亦或是冰凍爆炸的震撼效果？選擇你的風格，盡情在賽道上馳騁，展現你的非凡實力！
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]全都收集？當然要全都收集！[/b]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/f37d57c39a460830e62432570b8a28ee.poster.avif?t=1760426386" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/f37d57c39a460830e62432570b8a28ee.webm?t=1760426386" width="616" height="150"][/imgvid]鯨魚、奶油和極速賽車！總有一款卡丁車適合你！用各式裝飾品裝點你的愛車，無論是炫耀你的輝煌成就，還是純粹為了搞怪一把，筷子、雨傘、甚至萌寵都能成為你長途馳騁的絕佳伴侶！自由搭配，創意無限！
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]緊張刺激的多人對戰[/b]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/6f87e0dbd97808ff5b3b686d63ab95b4.poster.avif?t=1760426386" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/6f87e0dbd97808ff5b3b686d63ab95b4.webm?t=1760426386" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid]與世界各地的賽車高手一決高下！組隊或單人挑戰，衝擊全球排行榜！如果你更偏愛休閒玩法，那就與好友一起創建專屬遊樂廳！展示你的飄移技巧和終極技能，讓賽道沸騰起來！ 
[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]挑戰模式[/b] [/p][p][img width="609" height="153"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/5cf362cc763c559b7c83d05ebc696a3c.avif?t=1760426386[/img]更多精彩內容等你來探索！踏上冒險地圖，迎接一場場融合技巧賽道、極限障礙和獨特挑戰場景的賽車盛宴！在這裡，你將不斷突破自我，挑戰極限，成為真正的賽車王者！
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/04f42029a19372491cfad4db2ba26bf2.poster.avif?t=1760426386" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2598980/extras/04f42029a19372491cfad4db2ba26bf2.webm?t=1760426386" width="616" height="100"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][b]Oh Baby![/b][/p]
data.strSnippet: 卡丁車競速、終極技能系統、超過100款賽車、100+挑戰關卡，還有競速王和雙人大獎賽等獨特模式等你來體驗！
